Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. I attached a pricing model that maps commit tiers to expected throughput and the isolation add-ons we offer. Quick summary in case procurement needs the TL;DR:

- Single-tenant isolation premium: typically a step-up relative to shared Dedicated driven by two factors: (a) host/cluster isolation (32–40% premium), and (b) compliance integrations (KMS/longer audit retention) which we price as a fixed monthly add-on.
- For your 3M tokens/day / 10 concurrent streams: we'd recommend a 3x baseline headroom commit (i.e., committed capacity sized to ~9M tokens/day) to keep p99 latency targets within 120ms under typical burst patterns; this maps to the 3-node GPU pool in the attached model.
- Throughput guarantee: we can contract p95 throughput SLO on reserved capacity. p99 latency guarantees are offered as a creditable SLA only with higher commit tiers (12+ month and 500k+ token-per-minute guaranteed).

Attachments: 2026-02-11_Dedicated_Pricing_Model.xlsx (pricing + sizing), SOW_Acme_Dedicated_Isolation_v1.pdf (draft)

Two asks from our side to get a firm quote:
1) Confirm target commit term (12 vs 24 months)
2) Confirm whether you will require BYOK (customer-managed KMS) vs Redwood-managed keys — BYOK has an integration uplift and HSM KMS connector fee.

Happy to sync live with procurement and security next week.

Best,
Priyom Das

B) 24-month commit, 25% discount off list, isolation premium at +25% (reduced because of longer term), KMS integration fee waived, 2 months free trial on extra headroom.
